question: Where can I get annual agricultural crop production statistics in Spain, by crop and territory, with production volume, crop area, yield and historical series?

answer.summary: MAPA is the official source. Its 2025 provisional workbooks by crop group give national, comunidad and province tables plus a long-format database (sown, cultivated and harvested area; harvested production; provincial yields for secano and regadío). The Anuario de Estadística 2025, chapter 7, holds the consolidated 2024 data and series from 2014. The July 2026 monthly advance gives provisional 2026 cereal estimates. Eurostat's national and NUTS 2 series and the ESYRCE area survey cross-check the figures. MAPA documents its municipal crop-area survey as not disseminated (IME 2014); Catalonia publishes municipal woody-crop areas as open data.
main_caveats: 2025 figures are provisional. MAPA says the Anuario consolidates them; 2024 is the consolidated edition.
Olive national TOTAL row yields (1,427 and 4,069 kg/ha) repeat in 2024 and 2025 and do not match production over harvested area. Compute yields from the tables.
Yields reproduce as production over harvested area (checked for cereals, olive, Jaén, Spain). The 2013 notes define yield over cultivated area.
The olive series changes in 2023: double-purpose groves are added and harvested area is redefined. Do not splice across 2023 without adjustment.
MAPA's IME (2014) says municipal crop areas are not disseminated. Catalonia's municipal open data covers woody crops, as area only (no tonnes or yields).
Eurostat's Spanish 2025 production is about 3% below MAPA's provisional figure (Castilla y León 3.9%). For 2024 the two agree within 0.1%.
answer.confidence_reason: Core figures were recomputed from the official files (national sums match the tables; yields reproduce). Unresolved: 2025 provisional status, olive national yield cells, and the Eurostat 2025 gap.

attributes.note: Crop codes and names in the BD and Anuario tables (e.g. CE1110 soft and semi-hard wheat, OL1000 total olive grove). Olive oil kept apart from harvested olives.
Spain without Ceuta and Melilla: national, comunidad aggregates and 50 provinces in the MAPA BD. No municipal release documented (IME 2014).
Harvest year: 2025 provisional, 2024 consolidated, 2026 monthly estimate; wheat and olive series 2014-2024; Eurostat 2000-2025.
Harvested grain and olives in tonnes by province; olive oil in tonnes as processed output (2024: 1,401,354 t; 2025 provisional: 1,294,649 t).
Hectares sown, cultivated and harvested (cereals); olive grove planted, in production and harvested. ESYRCE gives survey areas by province.
kg/ha by province for secano and regadío on harvested area (verified). National totals must be computed; olive national summary cells do not reproduce.

steps: Download the crop-group workbook (about 54 MB; the BD sheet is about 464 MB uncompressed). Read it with a streaming reader, not a full load.
Filter the BD sheet by PRO_ID, CSP_DCW_AB1234 and CSP_DCW_TXYZ; read the value in column J.
National area and production: sum the 50 provinces. This reproduces TABLA GLOBAL NACIONAL for the flows checked (SSTO, SCOT, PCOG, PTBG, PRNC for CE1110; SRRT, PTRE for OL1000).
Yields: use RSCS/RSCR by province (kg/ha, secano and regadío). Do not add yields. National yield cells are '-' for cereals in TABLA GLOBAL NACIONAL.
Processed olive products: 'TABLA GLOBAL PRODUCTOS ANUARIO' and 'TABLA GLOBAL ACEITE OL ANUARIO' in the olive workbook.
reading_traps: Every crop-group workbook embeds the same BD sheet, named 'BD_HORTALIZAS-NO' although it covers all crop groups (914,700 data rows).
The BD header lists 10 names for 12 cells. Use column J for the value; column L repeats it; column K is a key.
The national TOTAL OLIVAR yield cells (1427 secano, 4069 regadío, kg/ha) do not equal production over harvested area in the same row (about 2,400 and 5,476 kg/ha), and repeat the 2024 Anuario values.
2025 values are provisional. The Anuario 2025 holds the consolidated 2024 values, which are a different data version.
'Aceite de oliva (t)' is processed output by province, not harvested olive production.

steps: Open the chapter workbook and pick the detail sheet for the crop: 7.1.2.6.1 (soft and semi-hard wheat), 7.12.1.1 (total olive grove), 7.12.2.1 (olive products), 7.12.3.1 (virgin olive oil by type).

reading_traps: The olive summary sheet ('Olivar: resumen nacional, 2024') shows TOTAL yields of 1427 and 4069 kg/ha. The national row of sheet 7.12.1.1 in the same edition gives 2,483 and 6,065 kg/ha, which equals production over harvested area.

In sheet 7.12.1.5 the first block is headed 'OLIVAR ACEITUNA DE ALMAZARA', but its 2024 values (2,645.68 thousand ha; 8,310.25 thousand t) equal the national total olive grove. Check the block labels before use.
Jaén 2024: harvested area equals area in production (589,047 ha in both). The 2025 provisional file gives 512,343 ha harvested against 588,876 ha planted. Check the definition before comparing years.
Yield units differ: kg/ha in detail sheets, qm/ha in the olive series. 33.05 qm/ha = 3,305 kg/ha, which equals 2024 national olive production over harvested area.
Municipal data are not in this workbook.

open_questions: Municipal 1TM data: is any municipal crop-area table public today? The MAPA IME (2014) says no. Ask MAPA. The Andalucía municipal statistic (MT 09.02.28, annual web publication) was not located for download in two searches.

Which 2025 version is current? The provisional workbook gives CE1110 harvested 1,795,163 ha and 7,788,554 t; the July 2026 advance gives 'trigo blando' 2025 as 1,791.0 thousand ha and 7,755.0 thousand t.
The national TOTAL OLIVAR yield cells (1,427 and 4,069 kg/ha) repeat in 2024 and 2025 and do not reproduce. Ask MAPA whether they are stale formula cells.
Olive harvested-area definition: 2024 sets harvested equal to area in production for Jaén; 2025 does not. Ask MAPA which definition the 2025 series uses.

Olive oil reference period: the oil figures (2024: 1,401,354 t; 2025 provisional: 1,294,649 t) are not tied to a stated oil campaign in the files read. Check the chapter 7 methodology for olive products.
Eurostat 2025 production is 3.05% below MAPA's provisional figure nationally and 3.86% in Castilla y León. The cause (humidity basis or version) is not established.
FAOSTAT (FAO, non-official) returned HTTP 521 on two attempts on 2026-11-19. Retry later to test a non-official national series.
Olive series 7.12.1.5: confirm which block is the total olive grove before using the 2014-2024 series.
The publication date of the 2025 provisional workbooks is not shown on the MAPA page. Confirm with MAPA.
Eurostat permanent-crop table for olives: the metadata mentions olives among permanent crops, but the table was not located.

history.note: Pass 1: MAPA 2025 provisional workbooks and Anuario 2025 checked at national, province and series level. ESYRCE, Eurostat and the 2026 advance added as cross-checks. Municipal data only in Catalonia.

Yield in kg/ha (RSCS secano, RSCR regadío); olive series in qm/ha
